title: The Garrison Blood Debt
synopsis: Colonel Harven demands the summary surrender of Ola Vask, a former garrison conscript sheltered in your bunker, threatening total diesel embargo.

stages.title: The Colonel's Notice
stages.narrativePrompt: A garrison courier delivers a wax-sealed notice: Ola Vask is wanted for desertion. She's been in your bunker sixty-two days.

choices.text: Confront Ola privately before answering the garrison.
choices.outcomeNarrative: Ola confesses she fled after refusing an order to execute a civilian camp.

choices.text: Surrender Ola to the garrison courier.
choices.outcomeNarrative: Ola is marched away in irons. The bunker descends into silent hostility.

stages.title: What She Saw
stages.narrativePrompt: Ola explains the civilian camp incident. 'I know what the math looks like. Do what you need to do.'

choices.text: Forge medical exemption papers certifying her as essential.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The forged papers hold up under inspection, buying permanent safety.

title: The Living Seed Vault
synopsis: The Works request assistance securing pre-war non-hybrid seed stock from the frozen agricultural research cellar in Sector 4.

stages.title: The Agronomist's Map
stages.narrativePrompt: Tomas Lind arrives with blueprints to the agricultural basement. The liquid nitrogen tanks are venting.

choices.text: Send a two-person team with heavy insulation to recover the cryo-flasks.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The team breaches the frozen vault doors.

stages.title: Securing the Roots
stages.narrativePrompt: The cryo-flasks are located intact under three feet of hoarfrost.

choices.text: Deliver the seed flasks to Ottilie Frayne at The Works.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The Works celebrate the recovery. The future of Sector 4 agriculture is guaranteed.

title: The Northern Icebreaker Gate
synopsis: Coordinate the Day 360 maritime evacuation across long-wave frequency 142.850 MHz before the coastal pack ice locks the sound.

stages.title: The Carrier Wave
stages.narrativePrompt: Radio telemetry confirms the icebreaker fleet has dropped anchor in the northern sound. Coordinates require crystal resonator calibration.

choices.text: Install the quartz resonator and lock onto the naval transponder.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The transponder handshakes successfully. Evacuation waypoints are decoded.

stages.title: Day 360 Evacuation Gate
stages.narrativePrompt: The convoy trucks are idling at the tree-line. Sector 4's year of ash concludes.

choices.text: Evacuate all shelter occupants to the maritime icebreaker.
choices.outcomeNarrative: Your survivors board the convoy vehicles. The bunker is left behind.

title: The Penitent's Shroud
synopsis: Sister Martha flees the Cathedral Crater with an urn of unrefined radium salt, begging for refuge from cult inquisitors.

stages.title: Apostate at the Airlock
stages.narrativePrompt: Sister Martha knocks with frostbitten knuckles, holding a lead urn away from her chest.

choices.text: Admit Sister Martha and isolate the lead urn in the sump.
choices.outcomeNarrative: Martha joins your medical roster. The cult marks your blast door with ash.

title: The Brine Monopoly
synopsis: Collector Kaelen demands double water tithes under threat of shutting down Aqueduct Station 3.

stages.title: The Meter Seal
stages.narrativePrompt: Hydro-Baron wardens attach a hydraulic lock to your fresh water intake valve.

choices.text: Use machined brass fittings to fabricate a clandestine bypass around their meter.
choices.outcomeNarrative: Water flows unmetered. The Hydro-Barons suspect nothing.

title: Protocol Null Stand-Down
synopsis: Sergeant Anneke Ruhl requires an authenticated pre-war counter-cipher to disarm the bridge demolition array.

stages.title: The Unbroken Cipher
stages.narrativePrompt: Ruhl holds the detonator handle. 'Provide the authorization code or the railway cut falls.'

choices.text: Present the D/9 one-time cryptographic pad recovered from the command bunker.
choices.outcomeNarrative: Ruhl verifies the cipher, disconnects the magneto, and stands down the detachment.

title: The Freezing Core
synopsis: Sub-zero temperatures threaten to freeze the bunker intake manifold at -38°C.

stages.title: Ice in the Shafts
stages.narrativePrompt: The primary air blower is groaning against four inches of intake hoarfrost.

choices.text: Install PTC ceramic heating elements and thermal lagging in the intake cowl.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The intake thaws cleanly, restoring steady airflow to the living stacks.

title: The Cold Count
synopsis: Dr. Lydia Hart requires clean spectrometer tubes to prove the automated nature of the strike salvo.

stages.title: The Provenance Run
stages.narrativePrompt: The salt chamber mass spectrometer is ready for its final isotopic burn.

choices.text: Broadcast the isotopic proof across all civilian frequencies.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The truth that no living nation ordered the war destroys the legitimacy of all regional warlords.

title: The Valve Seat Concord
synopsis: The Works propose a perpetual medical-agricultural exchange in return for machined brass valve fittings.

stages.title: Ottilie's Ledger
stages.narrativePrompt: Ottilie Frayne lays out the Allotments agreement: clean penicillin for brass pipe unions.

choices.text: Sign the Allotments Concord and supply twelve brass valve fittings.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The treaty is sealed with a handshake. The Allotments clinic guarantees your medical needs.

title: Silt in the Sumps
synopsis: Spring thaw black mud threatens to drown the lower ventilation shafts of Bunker 19.

stages.title: Rising Sludge
stages.narrativePrompt: Radioactive silt rises through the drainage sumps, threatening the emergency generator.

choices.text: Install the heavy radon air scrubber and shoring props in the lower sump.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The mud is contained and the radon gas vented safely to the surface.

title: The Day 340 Signal
synopsis: Signalman Miller needs help aligning the high granite crystal oscillator to establish the global carrier wave.

stages.title: The Alpine Transmitter
stages.narrativePrompt: Miller reaches the transmission dome in a blizzard, quartz crystal in hand.

choices.text: Solder the 142.850 MHz crystal into the transmitter oscillator circuit.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The transmitter bursts to life. Across three hundred miles, voices respond in the static.

title: The Aurora Departure
synopsis: Day 360 arrives. Captain Alder sounds the final departure horn on the northern sound.

stages.title: The Dawn of Year Two
stages.narrativePrompt: The convoy trucks are lined up along the ice road. The sun rises over the thinned ash clouds.

choices.text: Present the completed muster manifest and lead your survivors aboard the icebreaker.
choices.outcomeNarrative: The icebreaker's engines roar. You look back at the grey valley one last time. The Year of Ash is over.
